_about: Numeric values copied from gamedata/flightmodels/<plane>.blk in Aces of Thunder (Gaijin Entertainment) so the builder does not unpack aces.vromfs.bin. cockpit.headPos/headPosVr = pilot eye position (build_native_overlay.py); cockpit.teleReticleTexScale = SBD telescope reticle scale (fit_sbd_native_reticle.py); gunnerFps = SBD rear gunner eye, report only (finish_assets.py, inspect_sbd_gunner_contract.py).
